name: product_sign
description: Identify positive or negative sign of a product of signed integers; matched control asks even/odd number of factors.
generator_code:
import random,json,math
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 ns=[random.choice([-1,1])*random.randint(1,9) for _ in range(random.randint(2,5))]
 expr=' * '.join('('+str(x)+')' for x in ns)
 items.append({'prompt':f'Expression: {expr}. Is the product positive or negative? Answer:', 'answer':' '+('positive' if math.prod(ns)>0 else 'negative')})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Expression: {expr}. Is the number of factors even or odd? Answer:', 'answer':' '+('even' if len(ns)%2==0 else 'odd')})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
